facts.business: Inducto Steel Limited is engaged in ship breaking, trading, and investment activities, including lending surplus funds and investing in real estate partnerships.
key_risks: Iron and steel price volatility affecting margins
Foreign currency exposure on trade payables and advances
Equity price risk on quoted investments
Credit risk on trade receivables and loans
facts.related_party_note: Surplus funds given as short-term loans; investments in partnerships with Calvin Divine Enterprises LLP (20% share) and M/s. Shree Balaji Associates (5% share). Register of Related Party Transactions maintained; transactions in ordinary course of business.
